Repointing a chimney stack is an essential maintenance task that ensures the chimney remains safe and efficient. It involves replacing the mortar between the bricks to prevent cracks, leaks, and fire hazards. This process is particularly important for older chimneys, which may show signs of wear and tear over time. A well-maintained chimney stack not only improves safety but also enhances the aesthetic appearance of the building. 

P.P.S. Do not forget the notice board.
